head: 41f82cccfb4824deec8f3c0763188530c161741d
summary:
Build attempt 2 (41f82cc) fixes the defect validation found last time. It does not change the gap validation could not close then. The landing half of the slice has still never been seen with this build.

Real-system checks:
- **Refusal through the shipped app.** After a fresh single-file publish, window case R-002 step (e) passed on the live desktop. It deleted gone\ after the scan and revealed victim.bin. The app logged Failed / NoLongerExists / 0x80070002 and put the exact refusal text on the status line. Explorer showed no new, moved, re-selected or newly visible window from launch until 2 s after exit. The fixture was cleaned up.
- **Product's Walk with the real shell (parse-only).** A probe loaded the Release Core dll and called ShellReveal.Plan + Walk with the real SHParseDisplayName, SHGetPathFromIDListEx resolve-back and ILFree. The open call only recorded, so no Explorer window opened.
  - O-015 is fixed: con.txt, aux.h, nul.log, com1.txt, prn.md and lpt1.dat now reach the open as Exact, and their ID lists resolve back exactly.
  - Bare 'con' and 'dup.' are still refused up front.
  - The new resolve-back check does not wrongly refuse any landing fixture. It passed the short deny-all folder; files at 161/300/1000 characters and a 300-character deny-all folder on C: (the shell returns 8.3 forms, 83/192/85 characters); and the same set on D:, which has no 8.3 names (it returns `\\?\` paths, 304/1004/304 characters).
  - A deleted parent and a deleted target with its parent kept both give Failed / NoLongerExists, and the open is never called.
- **Tests and rules.** The full suite passes (503/503). The engine's architecture check holds all 69 rules. The src grep finds no Process.Start, ShellExecute, explorer.exe or /select. The one reveal caller is MainWindow.xaml.cs:775.

**Not run: R-002 steps a–d and R-001.** These are the steps that open Explorer on the person's desktop and close it again through Shell.Application Quit(), which is operating another program's windows. That run is what criteria 1, 2, 4 and 5 need, including the cold first reveal within 1000 ms and the no-dialog / no-consent watch. Across two builds and two validations, no automated stage in this loop has been allowed to run it, so only a person can settle those criteria.

**O-016 and O-017 (owed to build-slice) are still in the tree.**
- O-016: R-002 still calls `[void](Check-Landing ...)`. When a person runs it, a failed or slow landing would print only 'FAILED: R-002', with no step and no millisecond figure. It should be fixed before that run.
- O-017: Close-CaseWindows still judges whether a window holds the person's tabs from Get-ExplorerWindows, which drops unreadable entries.

**Criterion 14 (Hidden+System) is not met.** The design deferred it; the spike measured 0/8 selected.

The stale comment at ShellReveal.cs:206 ('Exact comes from the shell's S_OK alone'), which code review flagged, is still there. Exact now also needs the resolve-back to match and the open to return S_OK.

checks.what: Full default Core test suite on 41f82cc
checks.evidence: Passed! Failed 0, Passed 503, Skipped 0, Total 503, 23 s (net10.0). Includes ShellRevealTests (real-tree refusals, reserved-with-extension Exact, >300-char Exact through the 8.3 resolve-back, dup. ParsedAsAnotherItem), SelectSwitchRuleTests, ArchitectureRulesTests and RuleCopiesAgree.
69 rules checked against 121 parsed files: every declared rule holds, including the select-switch rule and the no-ancestor-fallback rule.

checks.what: Review: nothing in src launches Explorer or hands it the select switch; one reveal caller
checks.evidence: Only two hits: ShellReveal.cs:310 (RevealAsync's definition) and MainWindow.xaml.cs:775 (await ShellReveal.RevealAsync(path)). No Process.Start, ShellExecute, explorer.exe or /select anywhere in src.

checks.what: Fresh single-file self-contained publish of the App from 41f82cc
checks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 publish src/FsAnalyser.App/FsAnalyser.App.csproj -c Release -o artifacts/publish -nologo
checks.evidence: exit 0. FsAnalyser.App.exe (139,913,880 bytes) rewritten at 2026-09-29T14:41:11Z (it was 14:27:23Z before). Output is the exe plus App and Core pdbs only.

checks.what: Explorer baseline before and after the window case (read-only, Shell.Application)
checks.evidence: 1 entry (HWND 723330, 1 entry) before and 1 after. The tabbed multi-entry condition behind O-014 and O-017 was not present.

checks.what: R-002 step (e) through the freshly published exe: parent deleted after the scan, refused, nothing opened
checks.evidence: Fixture lengths 161/300/1000/300 were ok, and both deny ACEs were confirmed unlistable. gone\ was deleted after the scan and before the click (gated). Hook row: kind Failed, reason NoLongerExists, hresult -2147024894 (0x80070002), status "'victim.bin' no longer exists where the scan found it, so Explorer was not opened. Rescan to refresh.". Check: 'no Explorer window opened, moved, changed its selection or showed for victim.bin ()'. PASSED: R-002, exit 0, 6.4 s. The case folder cf1cfd3c… was removed afterwards (checked).

checks.what: Product ShellReveal.Plan + Walk from the Release Core dll: real SHParseDisplayName, SHGetPathFromIDListEx resolve-back and ILFree; the open only records (no window opened)
checks.command: pwsh temp probe (reflection on internal Walk, STA thread) on %TEMP%\sl088-val2-<id> and D:\sl088-val2-<id>, deny-all via .NET ACL on \\?\ paths; ACEs removed and trees deleted in finally
checks.evidence:
Exact, open called once, resolve-back matched:
- con.txt, aux.h, nul.log, com1.txt, prn.md, lpt1.dat, plain.txt: returned path equals the requested path, 65-69 chars.
- denyall_short (73 chars, listable=False).
- C: f161 (back 161); f300 (back 83, 8.3); f1000 (back 192, 8.3); denyall300 (back 85, 8.3, listable=False).
- D:, where the short form of a 46-char folder name is the long name, i.e. no 8.3: f161 (161); f300 (304, \\?\); f1000 (1004, \\?\); denyall300 (304, \\?\, listable=False).

Refused, open never called:
- 'dup.' and bare 'con': Failed/NameUnaddressable 0x8007007B, from the plan.
- victim.bin (parent deleted) and deleted.bin (parent kept): Failed/NoLongerExists 0x80070002.

Each call took 0-78 ms. Both temp roots and the temp dll copy were removed (verified).

checks.what: O-016: are R-002's landing checks still swallowed?
checks.evidence: Unchanged. Lines 4131, 4138, 4148 and 4164 still read `[void](Check-Landing ...)`. Check-Landing still returns -1 at lines 4011 and 4017, and its last line (4022) emits $ms. So the ok/FAIL lines and the 'landed N ms after the click' line would still be discarded on a person's run.

checks.what: O-017: does Close-CaseWindows still judge the person's tabs only from Get-ExplorerWindows?
checks.evidence: Unchanged. Close-CaseWindows (3493-3506) builds $others from @(Get-ExplorerWindows). Get-ExplorerWindows (3425-3438) skips any entry with a null Document (3429) or one whose read throws (catch at 3436). No raw per-HWND count is taken from Shell.Application.Windows().

checks.what: O-014 fix present: Compare-ExplorerState as a multiset over HWND|Folder|Selected
checks.evidence: $held is a List of "$Hwnd|$Folder|$Selected". Each entry of the after-state is removed from it once, and any entry not held is reported. Step (e) passed with this code. The tabbed-window case it exists for was not present in this run.

checks.what: R-002 steps a, b, c, d: landing at 161/300/1000 characters, short and 300-character deny-all folders, cold first reveal within 1000 ms, Explorer already on the parent with a sibling selected, no #32770 and no consent.exe
checks.evidence: Not run, on purpose. Each step has Explorer open windows on the person's live desktop, step (d) opens one directly from the case, and the case closes them through Shell.Application Quit(). That is operating another program's windows, which this run may not do unattended. No elevation operation applies. O-016 also means a failure there would print only 'FAILED: R-002'.

checks.what: R-001: the existing SC-007 reveal window cases
checks.evidence: Not run, for the same reason: the case opens Explorer windows and quits them through Shell.Application. It has no -Step option that would let only its non-opening steps run.

Out of scope by the design (C-014, not material). The reveal-selects-hidden-and-system-items spike is still waiting on a person, and it measured 0/8 H+S selected under this PC's settings. Running it would also open and close Explorer windows.

criteria.criterion: 1. Short-path folder with a FullControl deny ACE: its parent opens with it selected
criteria.how: Product Walk with the real shell parse reaches the open as Exact for a 73-character deny-all folder (listable=False), and its resolve-back matches. Whether Explorer then shows the parent with the folder selected (R-002 a) was not run, because it opens and quits Explorer windows.

criteria.criterion: 2. Item at about 161 characters, under MAX_PATH
criteria.how: Walk reaches the open as Exact at exactly 161 characters on C: and D:. The window landing (R-002 b) was not run.

criteria.criterion: 3. File at exactly 300 characters, revealed from its biggest-files row
criteria.how: Walk: Exact at 300 characters on C: (8.3 back, 83 chars) and on D: (\\?\ back, 304 chars), open reached. The biggest-files-row landing (R-002 b) was not run.
Walk: Exact at 1000 characters on C: (8.3 back, 192) and D: (\\?\ back, 1004). The landing (R-002 d) was not run.

criteria.criterion: 5. Deny-all folder at exactly 300 characters, revealed from its tree row
criteria.how: Walk: Exact on C: and D:, with the deny confirmed (listable=False). R-002 (e) re-confirmed its fixture deny. The tree-row landing and the dialog/consent watch (R-002 c) were not run.

criteria.criterion: 6. First reveal of the run, Explorer cold
criteria.how: R-002's b-first order exists, but the step was not run. The 1000 ms bound on this build is unmeasured, and the spikes' slowest landing was 934 ms.

criteria.criterion: 7. Explorer already open on the target's parent with a sibling selected
criteria.how: R-002 (d) not run. Only the spike (12/12, pre-SL-088 code path) covers it.

criteria.criterion: 8. Refuse: target's parent deleted after the scan
criteria.how: R-002 (e) passed through the freshly published exe on the live desktop: Failed/NoLongerExists/0x80070002, the refusal text on the status line, and no Explorer change until 2 s after exit. The Walk probe with the real parse agrees: victim.bin Failed/NoLongerExists, 0 opens.

criteria.criterion: 9. Refuse: target deleted, parent still exists
criteria.how: Walk probe with the real shell parse: kept\deleted.bin gave Failed/NoLongerExists 0x80070002 with the open never called. The real-tree unit test also passes in the 503 run.

criteria.criterion: 10. Refuse: parse succeeds but SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems fails
criteria.how: Walk_OpenFails_RefusesWithItsCodeFreesTheIdListAndTriesNothingElse passes (fake shell, code contact only). ShellReveal.cs:232-234 returns Refused on a non-zero open, and the finally block frees the ID list.

criteria.criterion: 11. Refuse: parse fails with a code other than not-found
criteria.how: Walk_ParseFailsOtherwise_RefusesWithThatCode passes (code contact, fake shell). No real parse failure other than not-found was produced here: bare 'con' is refused by Plan before the shell is asked.
SelectSwitchRuleTests pass in the 503 run. Fitness: all 69 rules hold on the clean tree.
SelectSwitchRuleTests.TheRuleLeavesLookAlikesAlone passes. 'Open in Explorer' is in the App and Fitness reports no hit.

Not measured here. The spike measured 0/8 H+S selected under this PC's settings. The product still reports Exact from the shell's answers, with only the hidden note. The design deferred this as C-014, not material.

planned.evidence: The product's own Walk, with the real SHParseDisplayName and resolve-back, reaches SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems as Exact for deny-all folders at 73 characters (C:) and 300 characters (C: and D:), each confirmed unlistable. The window-side check was not run: R-002 a/c read Explorer's folder and selection by leaf Name and watch for #32770 and consent.exe. It opens Explorer windows and quits them through Shell.Application, which this run may not do.

Walk: Exact with the open reached at 161/300/1000 characters on C: (8.3 back) and on D: with no 8.3 (\\?\ back), so the new resolve-back check does not refuse any of them. Whether the right leaf is selected in the right parent within 1 s (R-002 b/d, compared with GetLongPathName-resolved paths or by name in Find-Landing at WindowCases.ps1:3444-3459) was not run on this build.

Fitness op=check (rebuilt): 69/69 rules hold, including the select-switch rule. SelectSwitchRuleTests pass (503/503). The src grep finds no Process.Start, ProcessStartInfo, ShellExecute, explorer.exe or /select. The only reveal is ShellReveal.RevealAsync, called only from MainWindow.xaml.cs:775. Walk makes one parse, one resolve-back, one open, and has no fallback.

The assertions that carry this item exist in Check-Landing/Find-Landing (WindowCases.ps1:4007-4023, 3444-3459): the window's folder is the parent and the target is the only selected item. They have not been executed by any stage on this build. They also still run inside `[void](...)` (O-016), so their lines would not reach the output. The product still reports Exact from the shell's answers (S_OK parse, matching resolve-back, S_OK open), as designed. The question to a person about app-side confirmation stays open.

By code, the SC-007 'Open in Explorer' goes through this same reveal (MainWindow.xaml.cs:775 → ShellReveal.RevealAsync → Plan + Walk). R-002 (e) drove that shipped command from a tree row through the published exe. The existing SC-007 window cases (R-001) and the new ≥300-character landing steps (R-002 b/c/d) were not run.

R-002 step (e) passed through the fresh publish on the live desktop. gone\ was deleted after the scan, and the victim.bin reveal gave Failed/NoLongerExists/0x80070002 with "'victim.bin' no longer exists where the scan found it, so Explorer was not opened. Rescan to refresh.". Explorer showed no new, moved, re-selected or newly visible window until 2 s after exit. The Walk probe with the real parse shows the same refusal and 0 open calls, for both a deleted parent and a deleted target.

obligations.evidence: Checked with the product's own Plan + Walk from the Release Core dll against the real shell (no window). con.txt, aux.h, nul.log, com1.txt, prn.md and lpt1.dat now plan as ask-shell, parse S_OK and resolve back to the exact path (65-68 chars), and reach the open as Exact. Bare 'con' and 'dup.' are still refused as NameUnaddressable. Windows 10 was not probed.

Compare-ExplorerState (WindowCases.ps1:3524-3531) is now a multiset over "$Hwnd|$Folder|$Selected". R-002 (e) passed with it against the person's live Explorer state. The tabbed multi-entry condition it guards against was not present (1 Shell.Application entry), so that failure mode was not exercised live.

Still in the tree at 41f82cc, owed to build-slice. WindowCases.ps1:4131/4138/4148/4164 call `[void](Check-Landing ...)`, and Check-Landing still returns -1 (4011, 4017) and $ms (4022). A person's R-002 run would still print only 'FAILED: R-002' / 'PASSED', with no step, check or landing time.

Still in the tree at 41f82cc, owed to build-slice. Close-CaseWindows (3493-3506) derives $others from Get-ExplorerWindows, which drops entries with a null Document or a throwing read (3429, 3436). No raw per-HWND count from Shell.Application.Windows() is taken. It is harmless for step (e), where nothing is under the case root, but unsafe for steps a-d beside a tab of the person's that is busy.

not_reached: R-002 steps a–d on this build: whether the deny-all short and 300-character folders and the 161/300/1000-character files actually land (parent folder plus a single selected item) through the shipped exe. A person runs `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case R-002`, ideally after O-016 is fixed so a failure names its step and timing.
Whether the cold first reveal (161 characters) lands within 1000 ms of the click with this build. The spikes' slowest landing was 934 ms, with the old code path.
No #32770 error dialog and no consent.exe during deny-all reveals with this build (R-002 a and c watch).
R-001, the existing SC-007 reveal window cases, including the 300-character step 10: `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case R-001`.
Step (d) with Explorer already on the parent and a sibling selected: whether that window is reused or a new one opens, and whether only the target ends up selected.

O-014 / O-017 conditions: R-002 and R-001 run while the person has a tabbed Explorer window with 2+ tabs, one of them busy. Not present during this run, and whether Quit() on a tab entry closes only that tab is still unmeasured.
Windows 10: every check here ran on Windows 11 26200 only, including the con.txt / aux.h parse that O-015's fix relies on.
Hidden+System reveals under Windows' default Explorer settings (Hidden=2). That spike is still waiting on a person.
The actual Explorer landing on a volume without 8.3 names (D:) with this build. Only Walk up to the open was exercised there; the window was not.
